READ: the four frozen evidence bundles 161fcdb9b7feae10, 74c5b8ade98d61c0, c874d36a065c5ff6, 01b6cc76bd242e2a, plus the scope contract and the no-ablation/no-sweep/no-reseed experiment policy.
OBSERVED: the bundles share e6 (l1_br 0.04671 with depth-1 prefix survival 1.000 vs resample 0.06363 with depth-1 0.497), e7 (teacher-forced NLL), e8 (K=256 canonical-pair co-clustering only 0.0822), e11 (same_first_prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067), and the round record that curved residual 0.05439 / global geodesic pull 0.05165 / PPMI fourth level 0.04823 all lost recall, loss tracking distance from the plain text geometry rather than prefix count; behaviour contrast is the positive predictor (+0.7104, Euclidean control +0.7170).
REASONING: the surviving degree of freedom is cell membership of a small, noise-floor tail, not the bulk partition. TOLLCAP-SID is the only arm that holds codebooks, token vocabulary, cell set and every cell size bit-identical (capacity-frozen transport with cycle-drop), bounds each relabel by the quantizer's own RMS error eps_rec, and derives its only scalar lambda = eps_rec/sigma_A; the Poincare radius factor 1/(1-||m_s||^2) prices entry into compact cells, so curvature is not decorative and removing either term changes the assignment. Its risk is an empty admissible shell. HCAUDIT-SID is second: its degree-stratified permutation null, emergent B_max, measured +/-5% prefix guard and residual recomputation are well grounded and keep the repair inside the measured geometry, but it changes cell occupancy and prefix counts (the quantity e6/e8 say is not the lever) and its 20-permutation 99.5th-percentile convention can reject nearly everything. BEHTIE-SNAP is third: curvature is honestly data-derived and level choice uses measured behaviour impurity, but its admissibility band rho_l = median squared quantisation error is roughly a half-population band, not a tie shell, so it risks repeating the whole-partition displacement that lost 0.048-0.054, it leaves deeper codes stale, and its 0.5/0.5 weights are not derived. SHELL-CURV-RQ is fourth: its 5% margin budget is a hard bound and the margin quantile is derived, but the curved metric acts only on PPMI behaviour points while the shell and candidates are Euclidean-defined, so the geometry-off control is likely to reproduce the same ranking (its own flagged risk), it edits the training assignment every epoch instead of a frozen post-hoc pass, and c=1 is a pure gauge carrying none of the measured radius/compactness effect.

RANK: HCAUDIT-SID | position=2 | reason=the degree-stratified permutation null (grounded in the 0.0907 vs 0.067 permuted-prefix contrast) plus the emergent 5% budget, Lorentzian score and measured +/-5% prefix guard keep a behaviour-contrast-driven repair inside the measured geometry, but it deliberately changes cell occupancy and prefix counts that e6/e8 show are not the recall lever and its 20-permutation 99.5th-percentile convention may reject almost every item.
RANK: BEHTIE-SNAP | position=3 | reason=curvature c=(artanh(0.9)/q95||b||)^2 and the behaviour-impurity level choice are properly data-derived, but rho_l = median squared quantisation error is roughly a half-population band rather than a tie shell, so the edit can replay the whole-partition displacement that lost recall (0.048-0.054), leaves deeper codes stale, and its 0.5/0.5 text-versus-behaviour weights are asserted rather than derived.
RANK: SHELL-CURV-RQ | position=4 | reason=the 5% margin budget and B-quantile are derived, but the curved distance acts only on PPMI behaviour points while shell membership and candidates are Euclidean-defined, so its geometry-off control would likely return the same ranking (its own stated risk), it intervenes in the training assignment every epoch rather than a frozen post-hoc pass, and c=1 is a bare gauge carrying none of the measured radius/compactness effect.`;
